---
name: Reproducible defect
about: Record an observed defect with evidence, impact and a retest criterion.
title: "[Defect] "
---

## Affected revision and environment

Execution commit, module, operating system, dependency versions and run ID:

## Acceptance category

A1 installation / A2 cases and recovery / A3 contracts / A4 operations / A5 real UI, or explain why this is outside the agreed scope:

## Reproduction

Minimal inputs or sanitized fixture references, required UI steps, and expected behavior:

## Observed result and impact

Actual behavior, affected outputs or users, and whether work is blocked:

## Evidence

Sanitized logs, test failure, screenshot or artifact path and SHA-256. Do not include passwords, private keys, tokens or private research inputs in public issues.

## Closure criterion

The specific behavior and checks that must pass after correction:

## Fix and retest record

Fix commit, test environment, commands or UI actions, observed result and evidence link. Leave open until verified.
